profile.headline: Senior Backend Engineer｜Python/Django・AWS・電商與金流系統｜6 年經驗
profile.summary: Backend engineer with 6 years of experience building e-commerce and payment systems. Designed order and payment APIs serving 2M monthly users using Python, Django, PostgreSQL and Redis. Migrated services to AWS ECS with Terraform, cutting infrastructure cost by 30%. Mentored 4 engineers and introduced code review and CI with GitHub Actions. Earlier built data pipelines with Airflow and Kafka and REST APIs with FastAPI. B.S. in Computer Science from National Taiwan University.
